## 🇩🇪 German — Daily Phrases (3)
1. **Ich bin in meinem Element.** — [ish bin in MY-nem eh-leh-MENT] — *I'm in my element.*
2. **Das klingt vielversprechend.** — [das klingt FEEL-fair-shpreh-shend] — *That sounds promising.*
3. **Lass es auf dich wirken.** — [lass es owf dish VEER-ken] — *Let it sink in. / Let it work on you.*
